title: Configure firstmate as the study repo; fix pin tests that clash
summary: Set repo_url and repo_ref in athena.toml's [capabilities.study] to firstmate on main, as the first study instance. The two run_pin_tests failed because their config() helper inserts repo_url/repo_ref into the real athena.toml, which would now duplicate keys. Make the helper strip existing keys first. Running the M1 study itself is not part of this change.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test must pass, including the two run_pin_tests, with the configured repo.
The config is read by the study capability, which refuses to start without it; the tests guard the clash.
Only the config lines and the test helper change.
The retry reference and the failing test output supplied the missing detail.

assumptions: The study 'work handling (M1)' itself is a later study job; this job only configures the instance.
The failure came from config() in run_pin_tests.rs inserting repo_url/repo_ref beside the same keys now in athena.toml, giving duplicate TOML keys.
repo_url is https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate.git and repo_ref is main.
athena.toml is a governance file; it is listed and named in a criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [capabilities.study] sets an uncommented repo_url naming the kunchenguid/firstmate repository and repo_ref = "main".

The config() helper in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs removes any existing repo_url and repo_ref lines before adding or omitting them, so the with-repo and without-repo cases both work against the real athena.toml.
Run `cargo test`: all tests pass, including both run_pin_tests tests.
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.

out_of_scope: Running the study of firstmate's work handling
departures: The failure is already diagnosed and the fix is small, so I raised the verification pass chance slightly above the reference.
